title: Universe export
note: Candidate exports default to the machine Yoke home exports folder; an explicit output path chooses elsewhere and an unavailable destination names the repair. Serving proof is pending. A hosted fenced export pauses only the source tenant; its dump and receipt come from one snapshot. A failed or interrupted export automatically restarts the source. A completed export stays paused across restarts until an organization admin explicitly resumes it. Export completion is not destination acceptance or a storage transfer. Artifact transfer helpers accept caller-owned store routing and an S3 client factory, allowing hosted IAM credentials without machine aws-admin settings; omitted arguments retain machine routing and region checks. This library seam does not itself enable hosted export/import.
verification: Hosted export implementation observed; deployment proof pending. The existing Download archive control starts the hosted export. No dashboard Resume control exists yet.
